title: Leo Asked: What If the Moon Disappeared? 🌙 #shorts
description: Leo can't stop wondering about the Moon. So what would REALLY happen if it vanished? #whatif #moon #space #shorts

scenes.say: Meet Leo. Every night, he stares at the Moon, and asks a million questions.
But tonight, his question was huge. What if the Moon just... disappeared?
Poof! In Leo's imagination, the Moon is gone, and the night turns pitch black.
Here's why that matters. The Moon's gravity tugs on Earth's oceans, making them bulge. That bulge is high tide.
Without the Moon, tides would shrink to about a third.
Tide pools would stop refilling, and little crabs would be in big trouble.
But the scariest part? The Moon keeps Earth's tilt steady, at about twenty-three degrees.
Without it, over millions of years, that tilt could swing wildly.
Ice ages! Scorching summers! Total chaos!
Leo blinked, and looked up. The Moon was still there. Phew!
What should Leo wonder about next? Tell us in the comments!
